name: Coffee to Chocolate Parfait ~Kanojo to Watashi no Dog Days, Moshikuwa Hajimete no Shigyaku to Kyoujun~
original_name: コーヒーとチョコレートパフェ ～彼女とわたしのDog Daysもしくは初めての嗜虐と恭順～
source:
Rika grew up in an overprotective environment, but now she enters university and starts to live alone. But when Eriko suggest her a surprising part-time concerning Eriko's younger brother Hicky, Rika accepts it.
